verdict.rationale: Merchants get a documented self-serve start. There is a sandbox sign-up form with terms acceptance that unlocks test transactions, plus the public Trusted Agent Protocol spec. That spec comes with getting-started docs, public JWKS keys, and a reference merchant-backend and cdn-proxy for verifying agent traffic. However, production use requires contacting Visa, and there is no simple enable-a-setting path. missing for 10: self-serve production onboarding (fees and terms are 'Contact Visa'), a one-click merchant setting or toggle for agent acceptance, independent or hands-on corroboration of merchant onboarding.
